Background fetch is iOS 7. The iOS 6.1.3 dyld cache has neither setMinimumBackgroundFetchInterval nor UIBackgroundFetchInterval, so the system has no fetch wake-up. The backport UIApplication+BackgroundFetch7 keeps the interval and never calls performFetch. A wake would need a platform scheduler, which is not in the repository.

BackgroundTasks is iOS 13. The iOS 6.1.3 dyld cache has no BGTaskScheduler; beginBackgroundTaskWithExpirationHandler is present but schedules nothing. The backport answers submit with NotPermitted (backports-gaps N24).

Battery level and state are UIDevice API, present in the iOS 6.1.3 cache. Low-power mode is iOS 9: packages/e/expo-battery guards it and answers not enabled. Built into RNHost for armv7 iOS 6.0 from the package (isolated build, RN_EXPO_REAL=expo-battery; the module's symbols are in the binary). Not probed on the phone: the probe harness does not install the expo JSI global yet.
